security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://*.sentry.io https: http:; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.longDescription: DustNote is a single-user cross-platform personal note system. Passwordless registration with the master password as identity. End-to-end encrypted, supports .txt/.md/.docx import/export and controllable sharing.
